meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行完成视频渲染全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地或云端用命令行渲染视频
copy.tagline_en: Render videos from the command line across local and cloud environments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render videos via CLI on local, cloud, or serverless platforms

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令来创建、编辑、预览和渲染视频项目。它会执行代码检查、生成快照、比较版本，并支持本地或云端渲染。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或编辑视频项目、检查代码错误、预览效果、渲染视频，或诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个视频项目，命名为 myproject。
say.note: 运行 init 命令创建新项目。

say.text: 检查当前项目的代码错误。
say.note: 运行 lint 命令进行快速检查。

say.text: 用高质量渲染输出为 out.mp4。
say.note: 运行 render 命令生成最终视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run HyperFrames CLI commands to create, edit, preview, and render video projects. It performs linting, snapshot generation, comparison, and supports local or cloud rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a video project, check code errors, preview effects, render videos, or diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize a video project named myproject.
say_en.note: Runs init command to create a new project.

say_en.text: Lint the current project for errors.
say_en.note: Runs lint command for quick checks.

say_en.text: Render with high quality to out.mp4.
say_en.note: Runs render command to produce final video.
